description: List and search Security Playbooks from OneUptime with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting. Returns an array of Security Playbook objects plus the total matching count.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100.

query.description: Filter criteria for Security Playbooks. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

_id.description: Query operators for _id field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

createdAt.description: Query operators for createdAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

createdByUserId.description: Query operators for createdByUserId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

deletedAt.description: Query operators for deletedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

deletedByUserId.description: Query operators for deletedByUserId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

description.description: Query operators for description field of type Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

detectionRuleIds.description: Query operators for detectionRuleIds field of type JSON. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull

detectionSource.description: Query operators for detectionSource field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

isEnabled.description: Query operators for isEnabled field of type Boolean. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull

lastRunAt.description: Query operators for lastRunAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

minimumPriority.description: Query operators for minimumPriority field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

name.description: Query operators for name field of type Name. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

projectId.description: Query operators for projectId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

runCount.description: Query operators for runCount field of type Number. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

steps.description: Query operators for steps field of type JSON. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull

trigger.description: Query operators for trigger field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

updatedAt.description: Query operators for updatedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

version.description: Query operators for version field of type Number. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

select.description: Optional: field names to return for each Security Playbook (e.g. ["_id", "name"]). Omit to get all readable fields. Large fields excluded by default (request explicitly if needed): detectionRuleIds, steps.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Default: 0. Example: skip=10 to start from the 11th record.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Use "ASC" for ascending or "DESC" for descending. Example: {"createdAt": "DESC"} to sort by newest first.

name: list_security_playbooks
title: List Security Playbooks
